title: At the table
subtitle: Serving and pairing Vermentino
objectives: Know how long to keep it

steps.title: Mediterranean seafood
steps.body: Vermentino suits seafood and Mediterranean food: grilled fish, shellfish, fritto misto, pasta with clams, and pesto, Liguria's basil sauce. Its herbal notes echo basil, rosemary and thyme. Its saline edge suits oysters and anchovies.

steps.title: Service and age
steps.body: Serve at 8 to 10 degrees. Most Vermentino is best within two years. Vermentino di Gallura Superiore and some oaked versions can age three to five years, gaining honey and almond notes.

steps.prompt: Which Ligurian sauce is a classic match for Vermentino?
steps.explanation: Basil and pine nuts echo Vermentino's herbal, nutty character.

steps.body: On a Sardinian beach, Vermentino di Gallura with grilled fish is a simple, perfect regional match.

steps.prompt: Most Vermentino is made for long ageing.
steps.explanation: Not true. It's best young, within two years.

steps.title: What you learned
points: Vermentino suits seafood, pesto and herbs
Most is best within two years
